dataSourceInstructions: Use only these selected synthetic summary tables in lh_drillrun_summary: __dataset_summary_release_data, __planned_target_summary_release_data, and __offset_section_summary_release_data. __dataset_summary_release_data is the authoritative one-row release KPI source for global counts. __planned_target_summary_release_data provides planning-only target metadata. __offset_section_summary_release_data is target-expanded section summary data. For any historical formation accepted-footage totals, first constrain __offset_section_summary_release_data to exactly one target_id (canonical single-target slice) so each section appears once, then aggregate accepted_footage_ft by section_formation_name. Never aggregate historical totals across multiple target_id values from target-expanded rows. For offset comparisons, always filter exactly one target_id and never join pre-aggregated historical totals across target/section-expanded rows. Never query raw/detail run tables, raw/detail section tables, control tables, files, or individual run records.
userDescription: Synthetic v1.1.0 historical+offset summary source. Only selected serving SQL release tables are exposed; no raw or curated records.

children.description: One row per synthetic well with historical aggregate counts, footage, duration, date bounds, and quality flags; contains no individual run rows.
Authoritative single-row synthetic release KPI summary for total wells, sections, source/accepted/quarantined runs, footage, duration, and quality totals.
Four grouped synthetic data-quality summaries by reason and severity, with affected entity counts; no issue-level detail.
Nineteen source-history category aggregate rows for formations, bits, BHA, mud, and related categories; counts may include quarantined source runs.
